FCLoopFindIncompleteTopologies - finds all incomplete topologies in the list
FCLoopFindOverdeterminedTopologies - finds all overdetermined topologies in the list
FCLoopFindScalelessTopologies - finds all scaleless topologies in the list
FCLoopFromGLI - converts GLIs into explicit integrals with FeynAmpDenominators
